items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Me and my buddy, Hen-Pie, a saxophone player, you know.

ctx.x: Well, I worked around there for a while. I think that's when I joined Henderson. Because that was like coming down to '27, you know. Me and my buddy, Hen-Pie, a saxophone player, you know. He was a good tenor saxophone player. Henry Joel(?) or something -- Hen-Pie...
